1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan
Suruhanjaya Pilihan Raya (Pindaan Jadual) 2000.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini hendaklah disifatkan telah mula berkuat kuasa
pada 1 Ogos 1999,
Pindaan Jadual

2. Jadual kepada Akta Suruhanjaya Pilihan Raya 1957 dipinda dengan
menggantikan perenggan 12 dengan perenggan yang berikut:

"12, ELAUN KERAIAN BULANAN:

Pengerusi                                                  RM1,500
Timbalan Pengerusi                                    RM800
Anggota                                                                RM550".

Dibuat 1 Jun 2000.
(PM (S) 11334/1 Jld. 9; PN(PU*)373]

Dengan Titah Perintah,

Tan Sri Abdul. Halim Ali
Setiausaha Jemaah Menteri

P.U. (A) 222-223.                    1916

ELECTION COMMISSION ACT 1957
ELECTION COMMISSION (AMENDMENT OF SCHEDULE) REGULATIONS 2000
In exercise of the powers conferred by section 12 of the Election Commission
Act 1957 [Act 31], the Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes the following regulations:
Citation and commencement

1, (1) These regulations may be cited as the Election Commission (Amendment
of Schedule) Regulations 2000.

(2) These Regulations shall be deemed to have come into operation on
1 August 1999,                                                         a
Amendment of Schedule

2. The Schedule to the Election Commission Act 1957 is amended by substituting
for paragraph 12 the following paragraph:

"12. MONTHLY ENTERTAINMENT ALLOWANCE:

Chairman                                                            RM1,500
Deputy Chairman                                               RM800
Members                                                                  RM550".

Made 1 June 2000.
[PM (S) 11334/1 Jld. 9; PN(PU*)373]

By Command,
Tan Sr1 ABDUL HALIM ALI                !
Secretary to the Cabinet

P.U. (A) 223.
AKTA SURUHANJAYA PERKHIDMATAN 1957

PERATURAN-PERATURAN SURUHANJAYA PERKHIDMATAN (Pindaan Jadual) 2000
Pada menjalankan kuasa yang diberikan oleh seksyen 13 Akta Suruhanjaya
Perkhidmatan 1957 (Akta 393], Yang di-Pertuan Agong membuat peraturan-
peraturan yang berikut:
